title: Who's Still Breathing
text: Left-click a fighter or drag a box across your lot. Double-click to grab every blade of the same sort.

title: The Veteran Leads
text: That's your hero—the one carrying the banner. Keep them vertical; if they drop, the company scatters.

title: Hired Meat
text: Mercenaries take wages and stop arrows with their ribs. Keep shield-bearers in front and bows behind.

title: Number Your Puppets
text: Press Ctrl+1 or Ctrl+2 to bind selected fighters to number keys. Saves frantic clicking when fog turns ugly.

title: Point and Bleed
text: Right-click ground to march, right-click a foe to hack them, or use Hold Position before fools chase bait.

title: Dressing the Line
text: Pick a formation button to pack shields tight or spread out against fireballs. Neat rows live longer.

title: Borrowing Lightning
text: Select a caster, pick a spell from the bar, and click your target. Watch the blue bar—empty heads cast nothing.

title: Sacks and Scrip
text: Open the pack to strap on steel, read spell scrolls, or slot potions where panicked thumbs can reach.

title: Robbery in Daylight
text: Between fights, visit town merchants to offload muddy loot and buy iron that won't snap on first parry.

title: Eyes on the Horizon
text: Move your cursor to screen edges or use WASD to pan the camera. Blind corners hide expensive surprises.

title: The Bloody Corner
text: Check the minimap for red dots creeping around your flanks. Click anywhere on it to snap your view there.

title: Stop the Clock
text: Hit Spacebar to pause the slaughter and queue orders calmly. Heroes who never pause rarely grow grey hair.

title: Write It Down
text: Save your march before stepping into dark ruins. Regret is heavy; a clean save file weighs nothing.

title: No Crown Needed
text: Your campaign caches locally on this machine. Even when the road goes dead, your progress stays yours.

title: Wedge and Line
text: Cycle formations with the command bar. Lines blunt cavalry charges; wedges punch through narrow bridgeheads.

title: Control Groups
text: Press Ctrl plus a number key to bind selected fighters. Tap that key twice to snap the camera onto their boots.

title: Attack-Move Discipline
text: Issue an attack-move order into fogged ground so your vanguard engages on sight instead of marching blindly into steel.

title: Focus Fire
text: Right-click a single enemy caster or shaman with your archers. Dead hexers cast no blights.

title: Flanking Angles
text: Strikes into an enemy's rear or unshielded flank bypass block chance and hit harder.

title: High Ground Advantage
text: Archers perched on bluffs or ramparts gain extra range and accuracy while enemies climbing below lose theirs.

title: Quick-Bar Draughts
text: Slot healing and mana draughts onto your belt before a fight. Uncorking a vial mid-swing beats bleeding out.

title: Mercenary Upkeep
text: Veterans demand higher wages after each contract. Dismiss wounded deadweight or keep your purse fat enough to pay.

title: Equipping Your Company
text: Open the company roster in town to hand spare shields, boots, and charms to your hired blades.

title: Set Piece Synergies
text: Wearing multiple pieces of a named armor set unlocks passive bonuses. Hover any set item to inspect its thresholds.

title: Salvage and Smithing
text: Break down unwanted ironware at the town anvil for scrap and whetstones instead of hauling dead weight.

title: Scrolls and Tomes
text: Anyone with enough mind can read a single-use scroll, while permanent tomes teach spells for good.

title: Elemental Weaknesses
text: Bog-rotted flesh burns fiercely; flame-forged citadel guards hate frost and brine. Match your damage to the foe.

title: Interrupting Chants
text: Heavy bashes, shield slams, and stun bolts break enemy ritual casts before the spell lands.

title: Corpse Economy
text: Necromancers need fresh bodies to raise thralls or detonate carcasses. Fight near fallen foes, not empty mud.

title: Managing Threat
text: Taunts and shield-walls keep brutes glued to your heavy armor while robes and bows work unmolested.

title: Unstable Rifts
text: Optional rifts spawn relentless waves for rich loot. Clear nearby patrols first so you aren't pinched from behind.

title: Scouting Ahead
text: Send a single fast runner to spot patrol routes and shrine traps before committing your whole column.

title: Tactical Retreat
text: Sounding a withdrawal toward the map edge saves surviving veterans and gear when an ambush goes sour.

title: Hardened Difficulties
text: Higher difficulty tiers sharpen enemy AI, add elite modifiers, and starve your purse—prepare before stepping up.
